title: A Response to Sir Tim Berners-Lee: We Can Fix the Web Without Regulation
summary: Bitcoin Magazine A Response to Sir Tim Berners-Lee: We Can Fix the Web Without Regulation Tim Berners-Lee suggests the web’s flaws requires regulation to fix. But the problem doesn't lie in design alone: The entire fiat-based monetary system exerts pressure that distorts incentives and has shaped the web’s trajectory in ways Berners-Lee may not fully appreciate. This post A Response to Sir Tim Berners-Lee: We Can Fix the Web Without Regulation first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Conor Mulcahy .
